items.title: Phil Woods interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: we enjoyed a long, wonderful musical friendly relationship, and continue to be good friends.

ctx.x: It’s a great script, very creative.

I know, it’s a great script. But that’s the scoop on that. I mean I was headed home and here I was saved by a Frenchman. That’s kind of neat. And we enjoyed a long, wonderful musical friendly relationship, and continue to be good friends.
Well this piece, the string parts you said you were inspired or emulating Stravinsky in a sense.
